title: 第2574章 全知全能的高阳诚第2573章 卢潜带路
content_zh:
，，！
全知全能的高阳诚（全知全能的高阳诚（第22页）“救命！
救命！”
果然是高阳诚。
他从水中钻出来，依旧穿着那身灰布长衫，手里握着那把折扇，虽然是从水中钻出来，但浑身却毫无湿痕，他稳稳地落在地下长廊的地面上。
此刻，高阳诚朝张楚和童青山微微一笑：“你们别紧张，我就是偶然路过。”
张楚脸色发黑。
偶然路过？跑地底来了？你个糟老头子坏得很，我信你个鬼！
但张楚很识趣，知道高阳诚是世外高人，于是拱了拱手，语气恭敬地问道：“前辈来干什么？”
高阳诚的目光落在了童青山手中的长枪上，用手指了指：“青山手里的枪，有些不老实，我来管教一下它。”
张楚和童青山顿时一头的问号，你知道这长枪内有什么吗？你还来管教！
但童青山却猛然感觉到，手中的长枪微微轻颤，似乎很害怕高阳诚，他立刻给了张楚一个眼神。
张楚心中一跳，没想到这个高阳诚，竟然这么强，连黑龙王都能压制。
张楚急忙说道：“前辈，我们以后会老实的。”
高阳诚摆了摆手：“你们两个，都是好孩子，我知道你们会很老实。”
旁边，卢潜都懵了，这两个哪里老实了？哪里是好孩子了？您怕是不知道这两位的胆子有多大！
然而，高阳诚却继续点评：“就是这条黑龙，既然找到了主人，就不要总是出来了。”
话音未落，高阳诚手中折扇轻轻一打。
一声极轻的啪响在长廊中回荡开，一道神秘波动从扇面扩散出来，精准地笼罩了童青山手中的长枪。
枪身猛地一颤，发出一声低沉的哀鸣，像是什么东西被强行压了回去。

然后整杆枪恢复了平静，童青山大惊，急忙握紧枪杆试了试，发现黑龙王的气息还在，但像是被一层厚厚的东西裹住了，怎么都冲不出来。
他抬头看向高阳诚：“前辈，你把黑龙王怎么了？”
高阳诚慢悠悠地说：“没怎么，让他安静一段时间，既然是枪魂，就好好呆在长枪里面，总是跑出来可不行。”
卢潜全程看着这一幕，从最初的惊喜变成了错愕，又从错愕变成了绝望。
他挣扎着朝高阳诚的方向挪了几步，声音又急又快：“前辈！
前辈救我啊！”
content_en:
,,!
Omniscient and omnipotent Gao Yangcheng (Omniscient and omnipotent Gao Yangcheng (p. 22) “Help!
Help! "
It was indeed Gao Yangcheng.
He emerged from the water, still wearing the gray cloth gown, holding the folding fan in his hand. Although he emerged from the water, there was no trace of wetness on his body. He landed steadily on the ground of the underground corridor.
At this moment, Gao Yangcheng smiled slightly at Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan: "Don't be nervous, I just passed by by chance."
Zhang Chu's face turned dark.
Passing by by chance? Came underground? You are such a bad old man, I believe you!
But Zhang Chu was very sensible and knew that Gao Yangcheng was an expert outside the world, so he cupped his hands and asked in a respectful tone: "Senior, what are you doing here?"
Gao Yangcheng's eyes fell on the spear in Tong Qingshan's hand, and he pointed at it: "The spear in Qingshan's hand is a little dishonest. Let me discipline it."
Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan suddenly asked questions, do you know what is in this spear? You are here to discipline me!
But Tong Qingshan suddenly felt that the spear in his hand was shaking slightly, as if he was afraid of Gao Yangcheng, and he immediately gave Zhang Chu a look.
Zhang Chu's heart skipped a beat. He didn't expect that Gao Yangcheng was so strong that even the Black Dragon King could suppress him.
Zhang Chu hurriedly said: "Senior, we will be honest in the future."
Gao Yangcheng waved his hand: "You two are good boys. I know you will be very honest."
Next to him, Lu Qian was stunned. How could these two be honest? Where is the good boy? I'm afraid you don't know how courageous these two people are!
However, Gao Yangcheng continued to comment: "It's this black dragon. Now that it has found its owner, it shouldn't come out all the time."
Before he finished speaking, Gao Yangcheng lightly hit the folding fan in his hand.
A very light snap echoed in the corridor, and a mysterious wave spread from the fan, accurately covering the spear in Tong Qingshan's hand.
The gun body trembled suddenly and let out a low whine, as if something was being forced back.
Then the whole gun returned to calm. Tong Qingshan was shocked. He hurriedly grasped the gun barrel and tried it. He found that the aura of the Black Dragon King was still there, but it seemed to be wrapped in a thick layer and could not come out no matter what.
He raised his head and looked at Gao Yangcheng: "Senior, what did you do to the Black Dragon King?"
Gao Yangcheng said slowly: "Nothing, let him be quiet for a while. Since he is a gun spirit, he should just stay in the gun. It's not good to run out all the time."
Lu Qian watched this scene the whole time, and his initial surprise turned to astonishment, and then from astonishment to despair.
He struggled and moved a few steps towards Gao Yangcheng, his voice urgent and fast: "Senior!
Senior, save me! "
